system.effect: Once per encounter, when your Defense against an Attack with the Beguilement Threat would result in a Critical Hit against you, treat that Result as a Hit instead. Apply this after the roll and any reroll, before resolving the Attack’s effects. This changes only the Result against you.
system.description: When an enchantment catches your thoughts, something in you holds to the shape they had before it.
